ICC World Cup 2027 Ticket Ballot Sees 1.5 Crore Applications

The International Cricket Council (ICC) has received 1.5 crore ticket applications for the 2027 Cricket World Cup, which will be held in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia. The ballot opened 12 days ago and has received applications from 142 countries. The tournament is scheduled to take place from October 2 to November 21, 2027.
